description: A house 30 feet by 20 at 6 in 12 overhanging a foot all round, its east and north edges gables meeting at a corner: the south and west planes meet in one hip from the south-west corner of the outline to the north gable's edge of it. The north gable end stands on the north wall, a foot inside, and its top crosses the hip there, 20 feet from the west wall and 10 1/2 feet up, then runs level to the corner along the south plane (16.5); the east gable end rises along the south plane alone, from half a foot at its south corner to 10 1/2 feet at the north-east one, which the two gable ends share.
